issue_context.title: Refine cancel in test
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We use `admin.CancelJobs(txn, test.jobIDs)` in test to cancel a DDL job.
The code is a little complex and doesn't compatible with the new DDL framework.
We should use SQL statement "admin cancel ddl job" to achieve the same goal.

review_comments: @wjhuang2016 after #32954 merged this file is renamed so that you should redo the changes on `db_legacy_test.go` instead.

I found that is hard to modify these tests.
Because `admin cancel` is a query, is not easy to check its error.
I want to rewrite these tests and remove all of them.

The point here is to resolve code conflict. Could you elaborate under https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/28636 about which test you'd like to rewrite so that I can migrate other tests first and avoid code conflict?
